hooks.command: FILE=$(node -e 'process.stdin.resume();let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{console.log((JSON.parse(d).tool_input||{}).file_path||"")}catch(e){}})'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
